summary.text: Paul Crisci is the Republican and Independent Party of Connecticut candidate for the Connecticut House of Representatives, District 102, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Robin Comey. He is president of ParkGroup Solutions, a marketing and consulting agency in Newtown.

paragraphs.text: According to a Ballotpedia survey, Paul Crisci has been president of ParkGroup Solutions, an award-winning full-service marketing and consulting agency based in Newtown, Connecticut, since 2003.
Crisci was the Republican candidate for Connecticut State Senate District 12 in 2022 and 2024, losing both general elections to incumbent Christine Cohen.
The Republican primary for House District 102 in 2026 was canceled.
He listed public safety, affordability, and accountability as his campaign's key messages, and in a survey statement he said Connecticut has seen fiscal deterioration.
